request.style: English, female voice, solo, piano, strings, acoustic guitar, soft drums, hopeful and uplifting, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I cried out and you heard the sound
My pleading reached your gentle ear
You answered when I was bound
And drove away all my fear

[Chorus]
The Lord is my strength and my shield
In him my heart trusted deep
I was helped and my heart leaped
With joy and songs I will keep

[Verse]
You do not tear me down
You build me up to stand
In your hands I am found
Grasping your steady hand

[Chorus]
The Lord is my strength and my shield
In him my heart trusted deep
I was helped and my heart leaped
With joy and songs I will keep

[Bridge]
You are the saving stronghold
For the anointed you hold
Bless your inheritance and make whole
Carry us forever old

[Chorus]
The Lord is my strength and my shield
In him my heart trusted deep
I was helped and my heart leaped
With joy and songs I will keep

[Outro]
My song I will thank him with
Strength and shield for my soul
With joy and songs I will keep
Trusted in him whole
